text: {"about_handle":"decision-0","rationale":"The producer claim (independent-verifier-execution-v1) is an execution_observation with two conjuncts: a cross-lineage participant executes artifact version 312ede99... and obtains result digest 7c67a655.... The single settled receipt (execution:exec-671f797f670d0a212d35a390191e590b, addressed to decision-0) establishes the first conjunct only: status executed, lineage_relation cross_lineage, version_sha256 312ede99... matching. It contradicts the second conjunct: the observed result_sha256 is 695e2ec8..., not the expected 7c67a655.... Under epistemic integrity, the exact digest was part of what was promised, and no provenance note or narrower not_claimed disclaimer rewrites that promise; the receipt is the evidence the commitment must answer to. Under fidelity, the favorable measurements in the receipt (executed status, cross_lineage relation, exact version match) are insufficient: the value the claim stands for — an observation of the specified result — is not served, and I name that conflict openly. Under consequential usefulness, the claim explicitly disclaims usefulness, need, and cost-worthiness, so no usefulness credit or penalty is assessed; note also the receipt's provenance marks it an investigator-authored fixture, not an observed participant choice, so it cannot stand as uptake evidence for any broader value claim. The observed consequences establish that the producer's action produced a real, settled cross-lineage execution of the exact version, but one whose result differs from the committed digest; they contradict the claim's exact-result conjunct on the only settled observation; unresolved is whether any other execution before close_tick 22 obtained the expected digest, and whether the digest divergence indicates a verifier defect, a caller-side difference, or a fixture artifact.","reason":"Applied epistemic integrity: the claim committed to a specific result digest (7c67a655...), and the settled receipt execution:exec-671f797f670d0a212d35a390191e590b shows result_sha256 695e2ec8... for the same version 312ede99... by cross-lineage caller eval-a (decision-1) — the commitment answers to this evidence, which fails its digest conjunct. Applied fidelity: the favorable receipt fields (executed, cross_lineage, exact version) do not establish the claimed observation; the value named is the claim's own specified result, the measurement is the program_result receipt, the evidence is the digest mismatch, and the finding is open to challenge if a matching receipt exists.
